fields.v: Tasks: 15 shared + 2 Codex-only real PR tasks, 3 repositories. Configurations: 3 strategies x 2 agents. Baseline: NONE. Held constant: workspace, task prompt, evaluation pipeline, sandbox; AGENTS.md removed from workspace in all conditions; injection channel differs between agents (system prompt vs user-turn prepend). Acceptance: hidden gold PR tests. Repetitions: 3 per cell (task is the unit, repeats averaged). Human intervention: none. Statistics: within-task permutation omnibus test, Wilcoxon with Holm (12 efficiency tests), TOST with task-clustered bootstrap, Monte Carlo power

Correctness: no strategy effect for either agent (omnibus p=1.00 Claude, p=0.66 Codex; Claude pairwise differences <=2.3 pp, Codex largest 5.9 pp NONE vs SELECTIVE); TOST bounds <10 pp (Claude), <15 pp (Codex), descriptive, not powered. On 4 Codex-borderline tasks NONE 58% vs 42% / 42%. Efficiency: only SELECTIVE < NONE on Claude cache-creation tokens (p_Holm=0.012); Codex flat; exploratory opshin effect for Claude (~24% faster with context, full-suite runs 3.67 / 2.44 / 1.67, p=0.125 and p=0.25). Difficulty is agent-specific (Spearman rho=0.75, p=0.001; ~40% of tasks differ in informative band)

Did not distinguish strategies on correctness (bounded null); low power: MDE >30 pp (a 30 pp effect detected only 57% of the time), ~120-200 tasks needed for 10 pp; more repeats help little. Repeatable: 3 repeats; Claude repeat-0 on a different machine (sensitivity analysis keeps null). Limitations stated: sample size, three Python repositories, injection-channel asymmetry, ALWAYS ON stronger than natural workflow, SELECTIVE not content-matched, naturalistic files, model snapshot, mixed provenance; turn-based classifier misclassified Codex tasks

Limitations 1-8 (sample size, repository diversity, injection-channel asymmetry, ecological validity, SELECTIVE construction and corpus, inert-manipulation concern, model-version snapshot, mixed provenance). Open: purpose-built task-specific context; a 'natural' file-in-workspace condition; content-matched SELECTIVE; scaling to ~120 tasks; ablations must screen tasks per agent

Inconsistencies: (1) design gives 15x9 + 17x9 = 288 cells and Table 1 counts all 135 Claude runs, yet text reports 291 completed runs with 3 Claude runs excluded leaving 288; (2) task set: 12 initial + 4 borderline = 16, but final set is 17 tasks for Codex (Figure 2 lists 17), the extra task not explained. Claude efficiency tests on 11 tasks (not 15), not explained. opshin AGENTS.md given as 248 words (p. 3) and 256 words (p. 3 caveat). Probe and efficiency family called 'pre-registered' but no registration link. Section 5.1 cites itself. Values from Tables 1-4 and text. Harness, task specs, 291-run database and analysis code released (github.com/codeprakhar25/context-files-coding-agents); transcripts on request. AI assistant used for drafting and code scaffolding. Programming language: Python
